title: FOMO Sapiens (Patrick McGinnis) — 'You're not understanding. He doesn't work there anymore. This isn't a party. It's a wake.'
summary: McGinnis coined the term FOMO, wrote The 10% Entrepreneur and hosts FOMO Sapiens. Eric was his guest, opening on the wake scene that begins Incorruptible and making the case for calling the many ways of making money without creating value corruption.
blockquote: You're not understanding. He doesn't work there anymore. This isn't a party. It's a wake.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on FOMO Sapiens (quoted by Patrick McGinnis on LinkedIn)
attribution_title: Podcast hosted by Patrick McGinnis — inventor of FOMO, author of The 10% Entrepreneur
